title: redis-pusher APNS message
description: A message published on a channel mapped to 'apns', or passed to pusher.send('apns', message). Also checked by redis-pusher, which additionally requires `identifier` for messages published via Redis and limits the resulting JSON payload to 4 KB. redis-pusher ignores unknown fields, but this schema rejects them to catch typos.

identifier.description: Unique identifier. Required for messages published via Redis, where it's the lock key that makes sure only one instance delivers the message.

token.description: The hex device token of the recipient, or an array of them.

alert.description: The alert text, or an object such as { "title": "...", "body": "..." }.

badge.description: The number to show on the app icon. 0 removes the badge.

sound.description: The sound file name (e.g. "default"), or a critical-alert sound object.

contentAvailable.description: Wake the app in the background (aps.content-available). Without alert, badge or sound, this is a silent background push.

mutableContent.description: Let a notification service extension modify the notification (aps.mutable-content).

payload.description: Custom keys, sent at the top level of the payload next to `aps`.

expiry.description: Seconds from now until the notification is no longer valid. 0 means deliver once and don't store it.

priority.description: 10 delivers immediately, 5 saves power, 1 prioritizes power over everything. Default: 10, or 5 for background pushes.

pushType.description: The apns-push-type header, e.g. "alert", "background", "voip" or "liveactivity". Default: "background" for silent pushes, else "alert".

topic.description: The apns-topic header. Overrides the `apns.topic` option, e.g. for VoIP pushes ("com.example.app.voip").

collapseId.description: Notifications with the same collapse ID replace each other on the device.

retryLimit.description: Ignored. Retries are configured with the `apns.retries` option.
